segments.vv80:1.1: “Disvāna devaṃ paṭipucchi bhikkhu, ucce vimānamhi ciraṭṭhitike;
segments.vv80:1.3: Āmuttahatthābharaṇaṃ yasassiṃ [āmuttahatthābharaṇo yasassī (syā. pī. ka.)], dibbe vimānamhi yathāpi candimā.
segments.vv80:2.3: Āmuttahatthābharaṇo yasassī, dibbe vimānamhi yathāpi candimā.
segments.vv80:3.1: “Dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ, aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā;
segments.vv80:3.3: Dibbā ca kaññā tidasacarā uḷārā, naccanti gāyanti pamodayanti.
segments.vv80:4.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv80:5.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv80:6.1: “Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūto, saṅgamma rakkhissaṃ paresaṃ dhenuyo;
segments.vv80:6.3: Tato ca āgā samaṇo mamantike gāvo ca māse agamaṃsu khādituṃ.
segments.vv80:7.1: “Dvayajja kiccaṃ ubhayañca kāriyaṃ, iccevahaṃ [iccevaṃ (ka.)] bhante tadā vicintayiṃ;
segments.vv80:7.3: Tato ca saññaṃ paṭiladdhayoniso, dadāmi bhanteti khipiṃ anantakaṃ.
segments.vv80:8.1: “So māsakhettaṃ turito avāsariṃ, purā ayaṃ bhañjati yassidaṃ dhanaṃ;
segments.vv80:8.3: Tato ca kaṇho urago mahāviso, aḍaṃsi pāde turitassa me sato.
segments.vv80:9.1: “Svāhaṃ aṭṭomhi dukkhena pīḷito, bhikkhu ca taṃ sāmaṃ muñcitvānantakaṃ [muñcitva nantakaṃ (sī.), muñcitvā anantakaṃ (syā.)];
segments.vv80:9.3: Ahāsi kummāsaṃ mamānukampayā [mamānukampiyā (pī. ka.), mamānukampāya (syā.)], tato cuto kālakatomhi devatā.
segments.vv80:10.1: “Tadeva kammaṃ kusalaṃ kataṃ mayā, sukhañca kammaṃ anubhomi attanā;
segments.vv80:10.3: Tayā hi bhante anukampito bhusaṃ, kataññutāya abhipādayāmi taṃ.
segments.vv80:11.1: “Sadevake loke samārake ca, añño muni natthi tayānukampako;
segments.vv80:11.3: Tayā hi bhante anukampito bhusaṃ, kataññutāya abhivādayāmi taṃ.
segments.vv80:12.1: “Imasmiṃ loke parasmiṃ vā pana, añño munī natthi tayānukampako;
segments.vv80:12.3: Tayā hi bhante anukampito bhusaṃ, kataññutāya abhivādayāmi tan”ti.

lines: Vimānassa bahukālāvaṭṭhāyitāya kappaṭṭhitikatāya eva vā “ciraṭṭhitike”ti vuttaṃ,“ciraṭṭhitikan” tipi keci paṭhanti.
Sopi hi saṭṭhisatasahassādhikā tisso vassakoṭiyo tattha avaṭṭhānato “ciraṭṭhitike”ti vattabbataṃ labhati.
Yathāpi candimāti yathā candimā devaputto kantasītalamanoharakiraṇajālasamujjale attano dibbe vimānamhi virocati, evaṃ virocamānanti vacanasesā.
Alaṅkatotiādi tassa devaputtassa therena pucchitākāradassanaṃ, taṃ heṭṭhā vuttatthameva.
Hetvatthopi hi idha antonīto, bahū ekato hutvāti attho.
Anantakanti nantakaṃ kummāsaṃ pakkhipitvā bandhitvā ṭhapitaṃ pilotikaṃ.
Purā ayaṃ bhañjati yassidaṃ dhananti yassa khettasāmikassa idaṃ māsasassaṃ dhanaṃ, taṃ ayaṃ gogaṇo bhañjati purā tassa bhañjanato, āmaddanato puretaramevāti attho.
Turitassa me satoti sambhamantassa me samānassa, sahasā gamanena magge kaṇhasappaṃ anoloketvā gatassāti adhippāyo.
Aṭṭomhi dukkhena pīḷitoti tena āsīvisaḍaṃsanena aṭṭo aṭṭito upadduto maraṇadukkhena bādhito bhavāmi.

Tato cuto kālakatomhi devatāti tato manussattabhāvato cuto maraṇakālappattiyā, tattha vā āyusaṅkhārassa khepanasaṅkhātassa kālassa katattā kālakato, tadanantarameva ca amhi devatā devattabhāvappattiyā devatā homīti attho.
Tayāti tayā sadiso añño muni moneyyaguṇayutto isi natthi.
